punchline: Manson told a woman who had dated ten men to cut 80 per cent of the men she normally considered.
thirty_sec: Mark Manson separates fake freedom, more options, from real freedom, choosing what you give up. In an interview about his book he described a woman who had dated ten men with nothing lasting. He asked whether she wanted twenty men she felt nothing for or two she connected with. She chose two, and he told her to cut most of her list and set her standards by values.
